about: What each 2D asset breaks today, as audited. Written by `bun tools/art/check.mjs --ledger`; `grade` (1 to 5), `seen` (5 always on screen, 1 not in act 1), `eyes` (what the picture showed) and `owner` (another lead redraws it) are the audit's. docs/act1-2d-audit.md explains.

hero.eyes: The reference. Slimmer and smaller-headed than the rest of the cast (2.6 heads tall, they are 2), so he reads as from another game beside Dax or Hobb.

hero-moves.eyes: Stockier body, bigger head, yellower hair, both eyes with highlights.

hero-swing.eyes: Face redrawn with two large eyes and a fuller fringe; the idle shows one eye. The most used action in the game.

hero-cut.eyes: Close. Lighter hair, both eyes, head a little larger.

hero-camp.eyes: Good seat and rise. Both eyes show.

hobb.eyes: Clean and true to her sheet. Crimson went maroon in the palette.

dax.eyes: Clean. Pixels 16% larger than the hero's from the stretch to his height.

tansy.eyes: Clean. The honey-yellow apron went ochre in the palette, so she joins the brown crowd.

gus.eyes: Clean, but a cartoon moustache face where the sheet is a sun-worn farmer.

tamsin.eyes: Reads as a little girl in a big hat; the sheet is a lean older warden a head taller. Speckled coat, light hair with no outline.

maren.eyes: A child's proportions and a flower crown; the sheet and her portrait have a nineteen-year-old with a pushed-back crown in river teal. A smudge on the face.

elowen.eyes: Eyes shut laughing in every frame, walking too. The green stole went brown.

calla.eyes: The tallest woman of the cast stands shorter than the hero. Her grey coat came out half brown.

aldric.eyes: The nose is a red streak across the face.

ren.eyes: Good, and small: a sixteen-year-old drawn at 0.89 heroes.

ilara.eyes: Leaf-green tunic went brown; teal on both hands where the Mark is on the left.

auren.eyes: Burnt-orange waistcoat went maroon; stands a hero tall where the sheet has him the tallest.

custodian.eyes: A third smaller than its sheet and than its own waking sheet; fur tan where the sheet is moss grey.

custodian-wake.eyes: Four single frames with nothing between them: no eye opening, no stretch.

fox-blighted.eyes: Good. The leaf tail greys with it.

fox-blighted-fight.eyes: Good; the fourth pose is the well fox on purpose.

thistlehog-blighted.eyes: Good, and 8% larger than the well form it turns into.

boar.eyes: Good drawing. Nearly twice the height its sheet gives (shoulder 1.6 blocks beside a 1.8-block hero).

boar-blighted.eyes: Brown with glowing gold cracks; every other Blighted creature is drained grey with ash. 8% smaller than the well boar it becomes.

boar-fight.eyes: As the Blighted boar, and 13% smaller again.

lynx.eyes: Good. Pixels twice the size of the fox's beside it.

lynx-fight.eyes: Good. A stray pixel right of the side frame.

rootsnare.eyes: Good. The side row barely differs from the front.

mossling.eyes: Good. Pixels less than half the hero's.

lanternfly-glow.eyes: A glow, no outline by design.

stag.eyes: Painted with no outline and pixels twice the hero's, so it looks low-resolution beside him at the act's climax. Half again taller than its sheet.

stag-fight.eyes: As the Stag, and 10% taller than the chained sheet it follows.

juniper.eyes: Old cast. A pale halo on the back rows.

town-pell.eyes: Good and alike: maroon, cream and brown on every one.

town-corin.eyes: Good and alike: maroon, cream and brown on every one.

town-hesper.eyes: Good and alike: maroon, cream and brown on every one.

town-dunn.eyes: Good and alike: maroon, cream and brown on every one.

town-isolde.eyes: Good and alike: maroon, cream and brown on every one.

town-roan.eyes: Good and alike: maroon, cream and brown on every one.

town-nessa.eyes: Good and alike: maroon, cream and brown on every one.

town-pip.eyes: Good and alike: maroon, cream and brown on every one.

town-acolyte-a.eyes: Good and alike: maroon, cream and brown on every one.

town-acolyte-b.eyes: Good and alike: maroon, cream and brown on every one.

elowen.eyes: Golden hair and an olive robe; her sprite and sheet have silver hair and white.

custodian.eyes: Brown fur; the sheet is moss grey with a cream muzzle.

aldric.eyes: The portrait is right; the sprite is what differs.

maren.eyes: True to the sheet; the sprite is what differs.

juniper.eyes: Old cast. A stray mark right of the head.

act1-farm/moss-fiber.eyes: A tan knot beside the tan seed sack and the tan rope.

act1-weapons/bow.eyes: Redrawn 2026-11-12 with a dark outline and its own limbs, and drawn upright: a sliver 12 to 14 pixels wide in its slot. Second pass: on the diagonal.

act1-weapons/bow-spring.eyes: Redrawn 2026-11-12 with a dark outline and its own limbs, and drawn upright: a sliver 12 to 14 pixels wide in its slot. Second pass: on the diagonal.

act1-weapons/staff.eyes: Redrawn 2026-11-12 with a dark outline and its own head, and drawn upright: a sliver 12 to 14 pixels wide in its slot. Second pass: on the diagonal.

act1-weapons/staff-copper.eyes: Redrawn 2026-11-12 with a dark outline and its own head, and drawn upright: a sliver 12 to 14 pixels wide in its slot. Second pass: on the diagonal.

act1-weapons/staff-brass.eyes: Redrawn 2026-11-12 with a dark outline and its own head, and drawn upright: a sliver 12 to 14 pixels wide in its slot. Second pass: on the diagonal.

act1-weapons/staff-rootwood.eyes: Redrawn 2026-11-12 with a dark outline and its own head, and drawn upright: a sliver 12 to 14 pixels wide in its slot. Second pass: on the diagonal.

act1-equipment/canvas-jacket.eyes: Redrawn 2026-11-12 as a wide flat shirt 12 pixels high: unlike the padded jacket now, and too small to read as a jacket.

act1-kit/lamp-post.eyes: Redrawn 2026-11-12 as a lantern on a stake, readable, 11 pixels wide.

act1-found/old-brass.eyes: Redrawn 2026-11-12 as a toothed bracket; still not named without its label.

act1-kit/quill-strip.eyes: Redrawn 2026-11-12 darker; reads as a tuft, not a strip of quills on a board.
